name: Deterministic causal replay designer
brief: Learn replay programs that reproduce recorded logical outcomes using pinned observations and explicit causal order within an admitted domain.
context: External `event_journal`, `observation_objects`, and `causal_edges` variables retain complete event histories and replay prerequisites.

oracle: A frozen reference transition runner checks state hashes, emitted outcomes, and absence of duplicated external effects.

name: Executable resource-bound certifier
brief: Learn resource certificates for bounded executable cells that admit useful loops without trusting candidate runtime estimates.
context: REPL `cell_ir`, `loop_domains`, and `allocation_rules` retain complete programs, input predicates, and cost obligations.

data: Train from generated terminating programs, wraparound traps, rejected proofs, and checker-validated bound-construction action trajectories.

holdout: Hold out loop templates, integer widths, nested recursion structures, and allocation patterns with program families grouped.
